newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU sugar experts adopt GATT molasses duty rate.
newsitem.headline: EU sugar experts adopt GATT molasses duty rate.

text.p: The European Union's (EU) sugar management committee on Wednesday reintroduced the GATT fixed import tariff for cane molasses raising it to 0.41 ecus per 100 kg from last week's 0.32 ecus per 100 kg, an EU official said on Thursday.
"It is the first time that the GATT agreed import duty has been applied since July 1995. Future rates will depend on world price evolution," the official said.
The rate was based on a reference price of 7.73 ecus per 100 kg compared with last week's rate of 7.89 ecus.
The import duty for beet molasses remained fixed at zero with a reference price of 11.36 ecus per 100 kg.

A Commisison official explained that the GATT rate agreement fixed a maximum rate of 0.43 ecus per 100 kg in 1995/96, 0.41 ecus for 1996/97, 0.40 ecus for 1997/98, 0.38 ecus for 1998/99, 0.37 ecus for 1999/2000 and 0.35 for the final year of the agreement 2000/2001.
"The Commission has tried to be generous and kept the rate below the GATT agreement figure because the EU is a net importer of molasses," an official said. -- Brussels Newsroom 32 2 287 6800
